requirement_review.user_intent: Norven asked Cap to arrange the execution order for the known remaining RedCap revival issues after a Stop Hook recovery.
requirement_review.target_reality: The known remaining issues are ordered into a durable, checkable contract so later execution does not drift, rename tasks beyond recognition, or close the terminal parent goal early.
non_goals: Do not claim RedCap complete revival is terminally closed.
Do not treat this ordering contract as implementation of the remaining issues.
Do not bulk-read the old RedCap repository.
Do not bypass Prism if later steps move from ordering into implementation.

technical_review.rollback_plan: Remove runtime/core/known_issues_order.py, remove the known-issues-order branch from runtime/bin/redcap, and remove assets/contracts/known-issues-execution-order.json plus this lifecycle packet if Norven rejects the ordering or asks for a different queue model.
verification_plan: runtime/bin/redcap gate --task "排列已知遗留问题执行顺序" --risk-level medium --lifecycle-packet assets/evidence/lifecycle/known-issues-execution-order-lifecycle.json

prompt_context.source_prompt_excerpt: 你任务这些遗留问题的执行顺序应该如何排布？

task_body.requested_outcome: Create a durable execution order for known remaining RedCap revival issues.
task_body.primary_deliverable: A checked known-issues execution order contract and a local validator command.
acceptance_criteria: The ordering contract separates queue materialization, runtime boundary migration, legacy evidence policy, end-to-end acceptance, and terminal closeout.
The order explains why earlier steps unblock later steps.
The contract keeps the terminal RedCap complete-revival parent open.
runtime/bin/redcap known-issues-order check verifies the ordering contract.
The lifecycle packet can be checked by runtime/bin/redcap lifecycle check.

findings: 排序检查器保持为独立小内核，只读取合同并验证顺序、依赖和终局父任务开放状态，不触碰后续遗留项的执行逻辑。
合同明确把终局父任务保持为开放，并把终局关闭排在端到端验收与 15 项优秀设计覆盖证据之后。
本地检查命令会拦截顺序错乱、依赖缺失、终局关闭项缺少 15 项覆盖条件，以及排序合同试图关闭终局父任务。

completion_claim.scope: 只覆盖已知遗留问题执行顺序合同和本地排序检查器；不覆盖这些遗留问题本体，也不覆盖 RedCap 完整复活终局父任务。
